keywords.title: Deploy
keywords.description: Fires once, right after the card is put on the board.

keywords.title: Deathwish
keywords.description: Fires when this unit dies, wherever the damage came from.

keywords.title: On kill
keywords.description: Fires when a creature this card acted on dies — your damage, your consume, or the weather finishing off what you wounded.

keywords.title: Turn start
keywords.description: Fires at the start of every turn of this card's owner.

keywords.title: Turn end
keywords.description: Fires at the end of every turn of this card's owner.

keywords.title: React to ally death
keywords.description: Fires whenever another friendly unit dies.

keywords.title: React to move
keywords.description: Fires whenever a unit is moved to another slot.

keywords.title: React to enemy play
keywords.description: Fires whenever the opponent plays a card.

keywords.title: Melee row
keywords.description: Works only while this card stands in the near row.

keywords.title: Ranged row
keywords.description: Works only while this card stands in the far row.

keywords.title: Bond
keywords.description: The effect only happens if a unit of the same kind is already on your side.

keywords.title: Leadership
keywords.description: The effect only happens while you hold the leader condition on the board.

keywords.title: Weather
keywords.description: Weather sits on a whole row until the round ends. Playing weather on the same row replaces what was there.

keywords.title: Habitat
keywords.description: The effect only happens while the named weather sits on one of the opponent's rows.

keywords.title: Traitor
keywords.description: This unit is placed on the opponent's side and counts as theirs from that moment on.

keywords.word: first creature in the line ahead
keywords.title: Line ahead
keywords.description: A straight shot along the column: it stops at the first body it meets, no matter how many empty slots are in front.

keywords.title: Consume
keywords.description: Kills the target and adds its power to this unit.

keywords.title: Consume
keywords.description: Kills the target and adds its power to this unit.

keywords.title: Summon
keywords.description: Puts a new unit on a free slot of your side.

keywords.title: Cast
keywords.description: Plays a spell effect without leaving a body on the board.

keywords.title: Banish
keywords.description: Removes the card from the game: no graveyard, no deathwish.

keywords.title: Destroy
keywords.description: Kills the unit regardless of its power; it goes to the graveyard.

keywords.title: Set power
keywords.description: Rewrites the base power of a creature. Healing brings it back only to the new value.

keywords.title: Boost
keywords.description: Raises current power. Boosted power is not healed back — it is added on top.

keywords.title: Armor
keywords.description: Soaks damage before power does and does not come back on its own.

keywords.title: Heal
keywords.description: Restores power, but never above the card's base value.

keywords.title: Pull
keywords.description: Moves the target one slot towards the source.
